She is great on the lead and doesn’t pull. Penny hasn’t encountered children on walks but has been fine walking past dogs and people. She handles passing cars well, and even a tractor went past with no reaction.

She has growled at dogs in the kennels, but with slow introductions and trust-building, this can likely be managed. She doesn’t like getting into cars much and had to be lifted in to travel.

Her new owners will need to understand she needs time to get to know people.

Penny’s new home will ideally be familiar with herding breeds or understand their traits. She will need boundaries to minimize any guarding behaviour and should be kept busy with puzzle toys or jobs to occupy her.

Penny will need plenty of exercise, though this should be on lead or long line until she has reliable recall. She suffers from motion sickness in cars, which can be treated with medication.

She needs to learn to trust people at her own pace. Any males in the household should understand she is wary of men, and this trust may take longer to develop.

Penny was toilet trained and used a crate to sleep with the door open in her previous home, although she is not fully crate trained.

She may need a refresher in a new home. She has previously guarded food, so she should be fed in her safe space until this behaviour has ceased.

Penny will need someone around most of the day to gradually build her alone time and spend quality time with her to build trust.

Penny is a lovely, cuddly, playful girl who needs boundaries, patience, kindness, and time.

She needs to be kept busy to allow her natural behaviours to be met and given time to know she is safe and can trust her new family so that she can relax and flourish.

name: Maya
description:
Maya is a 4-year-old female Cross-Breed. She is spayed, fully vaccinated, and currently living in a private shelter in Romania.

Maya and her siblings were rescued as young puppies, and despite her early hardships, she has blossomed into a sweet and affectionate girl who loves both canine and human company.

She shares her kennel with her sister, Evie, and the two have grown up side by side. Having spent her life surrounded by other dogs, Maya feels most at ease when she has doggy companions around her.

She would likely enjoy joining a home with another friendly dog, though she could also adapt well to being an only dog if her new family provides her with plenty of love and attention.

Maya’s biggest wish is simple — to finally have a family of her own who will give her the affection, patience, and stability she deserves. She’s a gentle, loyal soul who would make a loving addition to the right home.

The rescue ensures a full home check, adoption donation, and lifetime backup and support to help Maya transition smoothly into her forever home.

name: Luna
description:
Luna is a 4-year-old female Cross-Breed. She is a calm and gentle dog with an endlessly kind nature, who has shown incredible strength and devotion throughout her life.

Once abandoned in the middle of a busy city, she was courageously guarding her seven newborn puppies, showing her protective instincts and maternal heart.

After being rescued and brought to Azil Danica in Bosnia, Luna watched her puppies find their forever homes, patiently waiting for the day she would get hers.

Despite her quiet wait, Luna never lost her optimism and continues to greet everyone who passes her kennel with a wagging tail. She walks beautifully on a lead and adores people, always showing affection and social grace.

Luna also gets along well with other dogs, demonstrating her friendly and adaptable personality in a shelter environment.

Her ideal home would be one that recognises her gentle, loving nature and offers her the companionship and stability she has been patiently waiting for.

Vaccinated, spayed, microchipped, and treated for fleas and worms, Luna is healthy and ready for adoption.

She is calm, social, and eager to form a deep bond with her future family, making her a perfect companion for someone who wants a loving, devoted dog.

After all she has given and endured, Luna truly deserves a home filled with love and care.

name: Rina
description:
Rina is a 7-year-old female Cross-Breed. She is a gentle, calm dog with a heart full of gold who has spent much of her life waiting for someone to notice her.

After enduring years in a harsh shelter, she has learned patience and resilience, quietly surviving without demanding attention.

Since coming to Azil Danica in Bosnia and Herzegovina, Rina has slowly begun to bloom, revealing her kind and affectionate nature.

She walks well on a lead and enjoys the company of other dogs, showing her social and adaptable personality. Although she ignores cats, her calm temperament makes her a perfect companion for a peaceful household.

Rina thrives in environments where she can relax and enjoy gentle interactions, always eager to be part of a loving family.

Despite her quiet past, she now expresses her affection openly, forming bonds with humans and other dogs alike. Rina is vaccinated, microchipped, spayed, and treated for fleas and worms, making her ready for adoption.

She would do best in a home that appreciates a calm, gentle dog who loves companionship but doesn’t demand constant attention. After years of waiting, she is ready to finally experience the joy of a forever home.

name: Victor
description:
Victor is a 3 year old large male German Shepherd Cross, standing 55cm from shoulder to floor, currently at the Nicosia sanctuary.

Gentle is the word all visitors use to describe this handsome boy. After being rescued, Victor spent over three years in private kennels under the care of his rescuer. Once space became available, he joined the sanctuary to ensure he finds his happy ever after.

Victor is an absolute sweetheart! He’s affectionate and loves cuddles, even with people he’s just met.

While he has been walked alongside Athena (one of the resident dogs) and ignored her, he’d likely be happiest as an only dog.

He enjoys playing, running for toys, and a good game of tug. Victor walks well on a lead and is happy to join you for a run. He’s clever and loves training, especially if treats are involved!

Victor could join a home with dog-savvy children. He’s a gorgeous, affectionate boy who is sure to make a wonderful companion.

SPDC adoption package and home checks apply.

name: Orla
description:
Orla is a ten year old female German Wirehaired Pointer. Orla is a truly gorgeous dog, inside and out.

Like so many older dogs given up to the shelter when they are no longer useful for hunting, Orla has a wonderful nature, calm and kind.

She seems amazingly well balanced given her background. She is confident and friendly around the kennels, getting on well with all the other dogs.

WIth people she is very attached and affectionate, not showing much fear. She walks well on the lead so far (that could change on an exciting walk) and she is calm in the car.

She loves her food, and now just needs a cosy home with some good company to make her retirement dreams come true.

Orla will be an amazing companion dog in the right home.

If you are interested in giving wonderful Orla a home, she is available at Setter Brittany Pointer Rescue. Orla is in Spain and is ready to travel to her forever home in the UK.

name: Oliver
description:
Oliver is a 2 year old medium-sized male Istrian Hound Cross, currently living at the Nicosia sanctuary.

Sweet Oliver is a gorgeous boy with the most fabulous long, soft ears! He was found by a man who wanted to adopt him, but unfortunately, the resident male dog was not a fan, so Oliver needed help finding a new home.

Oliver has adapted well to sanctuary life but would really love a home to call his own. He can be a bit of a goofball and enjoys playing, often picking up a toy to entertain himself and visitors alike.

He’s a big foodie and loves a treat or two. As an Istrian Hound Cross, he is likely calm and docile, but also a strong hunter, so he’s best suited to a home without small animals.

Oliver is very affectionate and loves cuddles. He enjoys meeting visitors at the sanctuary and is sure to be a loving and loyal companion in the right home.

SPDC adoption package and home checks apply.

name: Oscar
description:
Oscar is a 5 year old medium-sized male Istrian Hound, standing 46cm from shoulder to floor. He’s currently based at our Nicosia sanctuary.

Oscar joined our sanctuary with his friend Yennefer earlier in the year. We’re helping a dear friend and rescuer extraordinaire who’s been trying to rehome this sweet boy since rescuing him in 2021, after he survived one of the worst fires Cyprus has ever seen.

His companion Yennefer has since travelled to the UK, and we’re hoping Oscar won’t be far behind. He would truly thrive in a home where he can have a comfy bed to call his own.

Oscar was born with a malformed back leg and was likely deemed “no use” to the hunter who owned him, leaving him sadly discarded.

Thankfully, he was found by our kind friend and blossomed under her care. He made friends with all the other dogs and cats in her home.

Despite missing one of his back feet, Oscar walks and runs without issue—you’d barely notice anything amiss. He walks well on the lead, enjoys canine company, and could happily join a home with dog-savvy children (especially if they have hotdog sausages!).

It’s time for this brave, affectionate boy to find his forever family and enjoy the life of comfort and love he so deserves.

SPDC adoption package and home checks apply.

name: Storm
description:
Storm is a large-sized Old Presa Canario – approximately 3 years old.

Storm is currently in our kennels in Wrexham, North Wales.

Those of you who are local to us may recognise Storm, who has come to us from FOBK as she was struggling to cope in kennels and they were desperate to find her a lifeline.

Storm is extremely friendly & affectionate, once she gets to know you. Storm can be unsure when meeting new people and so will need slow introductions.

Please don’t let this put you off, Storm is obsessed with tennis balls and toys of any kind, she is more than happy to play until she’s worn herself out! Storm will never say no to treats, but most of all loves affection and a cuddle and then you’ve got a friend for life

Storm can be reactive around other dogs but will walk well alongside other dogs once control has been established with the handler.

She will need an adult only, pet free home who can continue to work on her reactivity and socialisation – believe me she will be well worth all the work!

Storm can be strong on the lead at times but generally walks well. She is muzzle trained and happy to walk with a muzzle.

Storm really is the sweetest girl once a bond & some trust have been established, she’ll then do anything to please you and is incredibly responsive.

We’re really hoping someone can see Storm how we see her and give her a well-deserved chance, she’s been living a kennel life for so long.

An adult only home, with no other pets is a must for Storm. This will ensure she can settle in and open herself up to become the best dog to her new family.

Trust us when we say once she knows you, you’ll have the best friend you could ask for!

A link to our adoption process can be found below:

https://celandinewoodanimalrescue.org.uk/adoption-processes/

Once we have received your application this will be reviewed by our dog team and if you are a suitable match one of our volunteers will be in touch within 7 days to discuss your application in more detail.

You will then be invited to meet the dog, and we encourage 2-3 meet & greets for you to get to know your chosen dog, we are happy to introduce you to multiple dogs on the day of they are suitable matches.

We do request all household members attend meet & greets including resident dogs.

If successful we will request a home check at this stage along with proof of identification and address. We will require written permission from a landlord for all applicants in rented accommodation.

Please note we require all resident dogs to be neutered and up to date with vaccinations before we will proceed with the adoption.

name: Tonic
description:
Tonic is an 8-year-old female Rottweiler. She was rescued from a public shelter in Romania and is now being cared for in a foster home in Evesham, Worcestershire.

Although her passport lists her as 8 years old, her foster carer believes she might actually be closer to 5 or 6. Either way, she’s still full of life and has plenty of energy to give to the right home.

Tonic is a lovely dog who enjoys the company of other dogs and loves to play with them. She walks beautifully on a lead using a harness and even waits patiently at the kerb until she’s told to move on.

Her recall still needs some work, but with consistent training and patience, she’ll improve over time.

She’s a sweet-natured girl who can be a little nervous at first, but once she learns to trust you, her affectionate and loyal personality really shines through.

Tonic would be happiest in a home with someone who has plenty of time to spend with her and is willing to offer her reassurance and gentle guidance. She’s already vaccinated, spayed, and microchipped, so she’s ready to settle into her forever home.

Because of her nervous nature, Tonic needs an adult-only home without children. She also isn’t suitable for living with cats, but she does very well around other dogs and could live happily with them.

Her rescue team provides full support, including rescue back-up and a request for occasional updates from her new family. She truly is a wonderful girl who deserves a safe and loving place to call her own.

name: Lupo
description:
Hi everyone! Let me introduce myself: my name is Lupo. Lupo is a 5 year old male Cross-Breed, weighing 25 kilograms.

He’s very sweet, gentle, and sociable — a loving boy ready to find his forever home.

For three long years I’ve been living in a small, bare enclosure, never truly knowing what it means to have a home and a family.

Despite everything, I haven’t lost faith in people: I’m very affectionate, even with strangers, and I love cuddles.

I walk perfectly on a leash, I don’t pull, and I enjoy going for walks in good company.

I’m ready to start a new life: the one I’ve been dreaming of for far too long.

I’m looking for a family who will open their hearts to me and give me the chance to finally know true love — the kind that never ends.

Could you be the one to offer me this chance, even just a temporary home?

name: Sissy
description:
Sissy is a 2 year old female Cross-Breed and is medium in size, weighing around 21 kilograms.

She was found wandering around a village, where she gave birth to seven puppies in the warehouse of a friend of one of the shelter’s volunteers.

Sadly, one didn’t survive, but the kind family cared for her and the puppies until they were old enough to move to the shelter.

Three of the pups were lucky enough to find homes, and the remaining three, together with their mother, came to the shelter once they were ready.

Sissy has been a wonderful and devoted mother. Now that her pups are grown, it’s her turn to find a forever home. She is a gentle dog with soulful eyes and a calm nature, happiest when she’s with people.

Friendly with both people and other dogs, Sissy walks well on a leash and has already won over all the volunteers.

Sissy is currently in Cyprus, looking for a home in the UK. She will be neutered, vaccinated, chipped, treated for parasites, and will have her own pet passport and rescue back-up from Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

name: Harry
description:
Meet handsome Harry! Harry is a 2 year old male Hound Cross and is medium in size. He’s a gentle, sensitive boy who finds shelter life a little scary.

Though still shy when meeting new people, he is slowly making friends with the volunteers and learning what it means to be loved.

Harry adores the garden and happily plays with other dogs. If you have treats, he’ll be your best friend in no time!

We believe that once he’s in a loving home, he’ll truly blossom — he’s already made amazing progress in such a short time.

Harry could live either as an only pet or with another dog. Please consider giving sweet Harry the chance he deserves.

Harry is currently in Cyprus, looking for a home in the UK.

He is neutered, vaccinated, chipped, treated for parasites, and will have his own pet passport and rescue back-up from Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

name: Jessie
description:
Meet Jessie, a 2-year-old female Cross-Breed who’s spayed, fully vaccinated, and weighs around 16 kilograms. She’s currently in a private shelter in Romania after quite literally rescuing herself back in May 2024 — talk about a girl with spirit!

Jessie is lively, affectionate, and loyal. She’s playful and thrives on interaction, exercise, and attention.

She still has some puppy-like behaviours, such as play nipping and jumping up to say hello, but with the right guidance, she’ll soon channel that energy in all the right ways.

She can happily live with other dogs or be the only dog in the home. Jessie is also friendly with people and may be suitable for a home with older children (16+) who are confident around bouncy, playful dogs.

Jessie would benefit from continued positive training and regular exercise to keep her both mentally and physically stimulated.

With consistency, she’ll grow into the amazing companion she’s already proving to be.

Home check and adoption donation apply. Full rescue backup and support are provided throughout the adoption process and for the lifetime of the dog.

name: Leo
description:
Meet Leo, a 2 year old male Shepherd Cross with a heart as big as his smile.

He’s about 62 centimeters tall and weighs 29 kilograms — a handsome, well-built boy full of life and love.

Found wandering the city streets, Leo was lost but hopeful, greeting everyone he met with a wagging tail and bright eyes.

Leo is affectionate, intelligent, and very people-oriented. He loves human company and thrives on interaction.

Quick to learn, he walks nicely on a lead and enjoys having a task or some training time with his person.

He gets along wonderfully with other dogs and is gentle with cats.

His happy, playful energy makes him perfect for an active home that enjoys walks, adventures, and a loyal companion always by their side.

Behind his shepherd looks is a kind, devoted soul who simply wants to belong and love someone who will love him back.

Would you open your home to Leo? He’s ready to give his heart completely.

name: Muffin
description:
Meet Muffin, an 8 year old female Cross-Breed with the sweetest heart and a story that’ll melt yours.

She weighs around 25 kilograms, stands 48 centimeters tall, and is a little on the chubby side — but that just adds to her charm.

Calm by nature and gentle with everyone she meets, Muffin loves people, gets along beautifully with other dogs and cats, and walks nicely on a lead.

She spent six long years living around a landfill, surviving on scraps and the kindness of strangers.

When the new shelter opened, she finally had a safe place to rest, but what she truly dreams of is a person of her own.

Muffin is more soft-hearted than dominant, always choosing peace over conflict. What she needs now is love, patience, and a quiet home where she can finally feel she belongs.

After everything she’s lived through, Muffin deserves her happy ending — a warm bed, gentle hands, and a forever friend.

Could you be the one to show Muffin what home really means?

name: Dony
description:
Meet Dony, the gentle giant with an even bigger heart. Dony is a 5 year old male Sarplaninac Cross, weighing around 50 kilograms and standing 75 centimeters tall. Despite his impressive size, he’s calm, kind, and completely non-demanding.

He came from an old shelter where life was far from kind, yet somehow he kept his gentle nature. He was named Dony after donating blood to a sick dog and saving its life — a true hero in every sense.

Dony gets along with everyone. He doesn’t bother with other dogs or cats and greets people with quiet warmth. He walks beautifully on a lead, enjoys calm company, and never asks for much.

Although he looks like a Sarplaninac type, he has no guarding instincts. He simply loves people and peace. What he needs now is a loving home where he can finally rest and be cherished for the wonderful, stable soul that he is.

Could you give this gentle giant the home he has waited for so patiently?

name: Nella
description:
Nella is a 1-2 year old female Cross-Breed. She was rescued from the old shelter in Bosnia where the conditions were dismal.

Nella now resides in the new state-of-the-art shelter established by the network for animals.

Nella is a happy girl who does love people and their attention. Nella must find a family who has the time to give her and isn’t away from home for long periods as this could upset her.

Nella enjoys the company of her kennel Mates running and playing. She also enjoys toys and playing games and when she’s not enjoying this she loves nothing more than a cuddle from her human friends.

Nella is a healthy girl with no known allergies or intolerances. She is vaccinated, blood tested, brucellosis tested, flea and worm treated.

Nella is spayed and microchipped. She has a secure garden with at least 5ft fencing and continued training and support. No cats as she doesn’t meet them or live with them.

Nella can live with children 10+. Dog experienced home who age understanding and won’t expect an Andrew pup to walk through their door. She is a rescue and needs time to decompress and learn all about her new world.

name: Lenny
description:
Lenny is a 1-2 year old male Shepherd Cross. “I am looking for a family of my own. I currently live in a private foster with my rescuer Kerala.

I like human contact very, very much. I like to be stroked and fussed as much as possible.

My rescuer describes me as such a lovely boy who only wants love. ? I would like very much a nice garden to explore and play in.

I am healthy, and happy and have no known allergies or food intolerances. I am not accustomed to living with cats so it’s best my home doesn’t have cats. I live with many other dogs of all ages and sizes.

I don’t live with small children in my foster. I have no bite history or concerning behaviour whilst being in foster.

I don’t know a lead yet so I will need some support with this in my new home, along with house training. I am not accustomed to seeing lots of traffic so will need support with this when walking.” – Quote

name: Lola
description:
Lola is a 5-6 year old female Cross-Breed. She currently resides in private foster in Romania.

Lola’s current foster home describes her as follows: Lola is a cheerful dog who enjoys running, going for walks, and playing with her son. She is gentle and outgoing.

She enjoys cuddling with friends and being stroked. She appreciates every bit of attention she receives from them. This sweetheart is also social with youngsters, and she takes care of them peacefully.

Lola walks well on a leash. She was in the first foster home for a short time where she was clean in the house. She is good with sensible, children 10+ and has no known health issues.

We would advise having Lola restrained by either a crate or seatbelt/headrest attachment in accordance with the law so that she does not try to bolt when trying to take her out of the car.

Lola is spayed, DHPPi/RL and KC vaccinated, and microchipped. Blood tested for disease, Lola will be flea and worm treated. She will travel on approved transport directly to her home address. Rescue back up and support available U.K. – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

name: Spud
description:
Spud is a 4 year old male Cross-Breed. He is described as an all-around great dog who loves human contact.

Spud comes alive when he is out exploring and is at his happiest being out on the field.

Spud is definitely up for adventure with his new family. Spud is friendly with females and males and enjoys spending time with his foster daughter.

Spud recently met the resident horse with no issues or aggressive behaviour. What a brave boy.

This intelligent boy is going to make a family extremely happy. Whoever adopts Spud will feel such joy with him.

Spud is on the smaller side of medium with a long coat. He currently lives in private foster in Romania but is ready to find a family in the U.K. full rescue backup in the U.K.

name: Dottie
description:
Did you ever see anyone as beautiful as Dottie? Look at all that fluff.

Dottie is a 1 year old female Cross-Breed.

She is vaccinated, Blood tested for disease, spayed, microchipped, flea and worm treated

Why is Dottie in shelter: Dottie currently resides in a shelter located in Romania after she was abandoned in a cemetery with her siblings. She was just a tiny baby then but now she is a big girl and is more than ready to spread her wings and find an understanding family.

Personality: Dottie is the most shy out of the siblings with unfamiliar people With her carers Dottie is very loving and sweet. Dottie enjoys walks and is totally lead trained.

A few nights ago there was a storm in the area and Dottie was afraid of this. In situations she finds uncomfortable, she will need support and reassurance.

Home needs: Dottie needs an understanding, dog-experienced home who will not rush her into any situations she could find overwhelming. It’s imperative that steps are taken slowly to gain her trust whilst she adjusts to a new way of living.

Dottie has never lived in a home and will need support from her new family with toilet training and time to adjust to a home environment and all the unknown items we have in our houses.

Health: Sadly like her siblings Dottie contracted distemper when she was little, thankfully she was treated with supportive care and survived. She doesn’t have any neurological problems but her teeth were affected due to the distemper.

They don’t affect her in any way and she is eating without problem but they will need monitoring as she gets older. Dottie is now blood tested and clear.

Rbu – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK APPLICATION and CHECKS apply.

name: Lola
description:
Lola is a 4 year old female Hound Cross. She is currently living in Bosnia Back up in the U.K. – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK Application, Process and Checks apply.

Lola is suitable for life with the other dogs and suitable for life with children 10+. NO cats, please.

“I am good-natured, cheerful, lovely and I love people very much. I get along great with other dogs and I love the time when we all play together in the yard. My wish is to be adopted by someone good, caring and of course beautiful like I am.

Adopters should be mindful of their actions and expectations, as well as be aware of the dog’s body language during any potentially stressful interactions.

Do not expect to bring home a fully adjusted dog who will require little training from you.” – Quote

name: Henry
description:
Henry is a 1-2 year old male Cross-Breed. This sweet boy, not even a fully grown dog then, wandered the streets for days.

Unlike many other dogs, Henry was not afraid of people, he walked up to each one of them hoping for a home, help, or just some food to go through another day.

His fate turned the day one of the S-PAS association volunteers saw him, stopped the car and just jumped in.

This story best describes what helped him survive alone, he took no chances, and when he saw an opportunity he went for it!

So what strange luck would it be for Henry if someone gave him a chance and did not miss out on an opportunity as great as him?

Henry is a middle-sized dog that needs a firm authority life companion. Ever since he was found on the street, he spent his time in foster homes.

From all the fosters we have had clear feedback about him not being an aggressive dog, just a baby in need of love and care that did not have the opportunity to learn how to behave during his life on the street.

Henry shared his living space with other dogs and children and did not have any issues.

Also, he knows well how to behave in a house, but as any dog, needs some time to adjust to new spaces and people.

In the photos presented, you can see him with short fur, but his hair grows very scruffy, terrier-like, but softer.

Henry is vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, neutered, and microchipped. He is currently located in Croatia Back up in the U.K. – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK Application, process and checks apply.

name: Dony
description:
Dony is a 4 year old male Shepherd Cross “I’m a little bigger, but my soul is twice as big as my body is. I love people, and I get along great with all dogs.

I am very proud of my act of humanity. On one occasion, I donated blood for a sick friend of mine and thus saved her life.

I would be the happiest dog in the whole world if I were adopted by people with a yard and space that I could fill with my love and joy.” – Quote

name: Tina
description:
Introducing our very special graveyard pup Tina.

Tina is a 1 year old 14 kg female Cross-Breed.

Vaccinated, Blood tested for disease, microchipped, Spayed, flea and worm treated.

History:Tina was rescued as a young pup with her brothers after being discarded in a graveyard almost a year ago now.

She has stayed in a private shelter, seeking a home.

Personality:Tina is an outgoing girl who enjoys company and attention. She is a loveable soul who will make a great companion.

Meeting new people:Tina has found no worries meeting new people in the shelter or visiting the vet.

Dog test:Tina lives happily with her siblings in a private shelter.

Cat test:Tina would prefer a house without cats because she doesn’t live with any at this time.

Home alone:Tina doesn’t currently live in a home environment. Adopters will have to understand though that She may be a little unsettled within the first few days of entering a new home with a new routine and new people.

Giving her time to decompress and adjust to her new home is key in supporting her.

Health problems:Tina was pretty ill when she regrettably contracted distemper when she was younger. Thank goodness, Tina received supportive care and recovered. She is now well and has undergone testing, and there are no long-term repercussions from this.

Home needsA home with children over 15 years of age. This includes visiting and resident children to the property INCLUDING. grandchildren, nieces/nephews, friends’ children. No cats as she isn’t used to them. Secure garden.

Rbu – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK APPLICATIONS and CHECKS apply.

name: Zara
description:
Zara is a 4-year-old female Mioritic shepherd cross, currently residing in Romania.

She stands tall at 67 centimeters and weighs 38 kilograms. Big and beautiful, Zara was rescued from a public shelter in Romania and is now in a private foster home.

She requires a dog-experienced household due to her past experiences.

Zara has been tested with the resident cat and showed no signs of aggression towards him.

However, her history prior to and during her stay in the shelter remains unknown, so patience and understanding are key in her new home.

It’s important for her adopters to be prepared to go at her pace and be experienced with rescue dogs.

Despite her past, Zara has been making great progress in her foster home.

She deserves a safe and loving environment in her next chapter of life.

name: Amira
description:
Amira, a four-year-old female cross-breed, stands at a height of 57cm. Rescued from a public shelter in Romania, she now resides in a private shelter while awaiting her forever home.

Despite her past challenges, Amira is described as super friendly and gentle, enjoying human contact and affection. She walks nicely on a lead and relishes her time outside the kennel.

For Amira, a patient and experienced home with knowledge of caring for big dogs is preferred. She understands that the journey to the UK is lengthy and will require time to decompress in her new environment.

A secure garden where she can play safely is also on her wishlist.

Amira has been fully vaccinated, blood-tested, spayed, and received flea and worm treatments. She also has a microchip and is registered in the Recs system.

With her own passport and import papers, she is ready to travel to the UK upon approval.

For those interested in welcoming Amira into their home, reaching out to the admin team is encouraged.

They will guide prospective adopters through the process and provide support along the adoption journey.

name: Dobby
description:
Just look at this wonderful, smiley girl Dobby.

Dobby is a delightful 3-year-old female Cross-Breed.

For more than a year she has been at the new shelter in Bosnia but prior to this, she was at the old shelter on the dump where the conditions were unimaginable. Despite this Dobby is described as the most beautiful girl who shouldn’t be spending her life in a shelter.

Due to her colour many people in Bosnia don’t give her a second look but if they knew just how wonderful she was then her fur colour wouldn’t matter.

She loves to be stroked and runs to everyone for love and affection whilst always having a smile on her face. She gets along perfectly with all the other dogs and she shows no aggression when she sees a cat although she doesn’t live with cats in the shelter.

How could anyone not want to love this girl?

We would love to talk to anyone who is interested in giving Dobby a loving home:

Currently in Bosnia Dogs from Bosnia have to quarantine in the U.K.

48hrs before arriving to their home. Application and checks apply.

name: Olivia
description:
Olivia is a 2 year old female Cross-Breed. She currently resides in private foster in Romania. She was abandoned on the street in Romania.

It is apparent that she had spent some time on a chain as she has a chain mark on her neck. Olivia hasn’t shown any behaviours whilst being in private foster.

Olivia is a kind and calm soul who is people friendly despite her previous trauma. She doesn’t show any aggression towards the other dogs, she has no bite history whilst being in private foster.

Olivia is a tiny little girl who doesn’t require lots of exercise. Two small walks a day with play time in between would be adequate for Olivia.

Olivia is a little shy at first in meeting with new people but Olivia is gentle with unfamiliar people. She likes to be stroked and loved with the people she trusts.

Olivia has shown no allergies, intolerances or issues with any foods whilst in rescue.Adopters will have to understand that olivia may be a little unsettled within the first few days of entering a new home with an unfamiliar routine and people.

Giving her time to decompress and adjust to her new home is key in supporting her. She is good with sensible, children 10+ and has no known health issues.

We would advise having Olivia is restrained by either a crate or seatbelt/headrest attachment as in accordance with the law and so that she does not try to bolt when trying to take her out of the car. He needs a calm and loving home who will give Olivia lots of love and affection.

A gentle home with not lots of comings and goings. You must have the facilities, time, financial means, knowledge and skills necessary to ensure a good standard of care. We require an APPLICATION and HOMECHECK.

Olivia is spayed, DHPPi/RL and KC vaccinated, and microchipped. She will be flea and worm treated. She will travel on approved transport directly to her home address. Rescue back up and support available.

name: Wolfy
description:
Shepherd lovers?? Introducing a very special boy called Wolfy.

Good afternoon everybody my name is Wolfy and I’m a 4.5 month male Shepherd, located in Romania.

I will be a large sized male at maturity weighing approximately 30kg. I am looking for a shepherd-experienced home with a secure garden for play time.

At the moment I am living with an older lady who rescued me, but sadly she can’t take care of my needs and this means I am not getting the exercise or mental stimulation that I require.

I currently live with many cats and other dogs. I like my food a lot and won’t say no to a treat or two ? I am described as a happy boy who always has a waggy tail when visitors come.

I walk on a lead and I do require a fit and able person to keep up with my pace. I have a lot still to learn and I’m looking for a home who have lots of time, patience and energy to help me grow and learn.

I can live with older children 14+ who are dog savvy and used to living with a dog in the home.

I am fully vet checked, vaccinated, blood tested, microchipped, flead, wormed, not neutered as yet due to age.

name: Zvonko
description:
Zvonko is a 1-year-old male Cross-Breed currently residing in Croatia. This young and energetic dog found his way to the shelter in early December after being brought in by a utility policeman from Vitaljina.

At the time, Zvonko wasn’t microchipped, and his background remained uncertain. However, through social media posts, his owner was identified.

Despite an initial agreement to retrieve Zvonko on New Year’s Eve, his owner failed to honour the arrangement. Attempts to contact him revealed a sudden change of heart, leaving Zvonko abandoned and in need of a new home.

During his stay at the shelter, Zvonko has been vaccinated, neutered, and microchipped, ensuring he is ready for a fresh start in a loving environment.

Zvonko has a friendly nature and gets along exceptionally well with both dogs and people, making him an excellent candidate for a family looking for a social and loving companion. His personality shines with warmth and affection, and he is eager to bring joy to his future family.

If you’re seeking a loyal and sociable dog to welcome into your home, Zvonko might be the perfect match. By adopting him, you’ll provide the love and security he deserves while gaining a companion who will reward you with endless happiness.

If interested, contact Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue to start the application process and give Zvonko the happy ending he longs for.

name: Ronnie
description:
Ronnie is an 8 month old small male Cross-Breed.

Vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, microchipped, neutered.

Ronnie is looking for a family after he was abandoned with his brother in Romania. He currently resides in a private foster house.

His brother just found a wonderful home but sadly no one for Ronnie.

Ronnie is a happy little chap who loves belly tickles and human interaction.

He walks on a lead and is described as very well educated and super social.

He doesn’t have any known allergies or intolerances and doesn’t take any medication. He hasn’t show any food guarding behaviour towards other dogs in the foster house.

Rbu- Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK Application and checks apply.

name: Bradley
description:
Meet the extremely handsome 4 year old male Cross-Breed Bradley.

This wonderful boy is ready for lots of fun with his new family.

Bradley is definitely the best furry friend you’ve been looking for.

A bouncy, cheeky, happy lad 4 Years old large size bundle of love.

He is more than ready to finally travel to his forever home.

Bradley loves water balls and running around the shelter playground. A fabulous boy who will keep you on your toes with endless hours of fun.

Bradley loves people very much and will let you throw his ball for hours. A active home is definitely needed for Bradley who have time and energy.

He walks wonderful on lead and is looking forward to lots of adventures in his new home ? No small children in his home due to his very bouncy nature.

Bradley is fully vaccinated, microchipped, flea and worm treated, neutered, brucellosis and leishmania tested, and vet checked.

Bradley currently resides in Bosnia under the care of Azil Danica 48hr quarantine in the U.K. for Bosnian dogs.

Rbu in the U.K. – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK Application and checks apply.

Let’s help make Bradley’s dreams come true.

name: Lucy
description:
Lucy is a 6-year-old female Cross-Breed. She’s a big-hearted, lovable soul who has already been through quite a journey. Rescued from Breasta Public Shelter in April 2023, Lucy was one of the lucky ones pulled to safety just in time.

Now she’s living in a secure shelter in Romania, waiting for her forever home through Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

Lucy is friendly with people, dogs, and even cats. Despite not currently living with them, she shows good social skills and an easygoing nature that makes her a joy to be around.

She enjoys human contact, happily accepting strokes and affection from those she trusts.

At the shelter, Lucy has made friends with the smaller dogs and gets along well with them. Although she’s larger in size, she’s gentle and well-balanced, showing patience and calmness around others.

Lucy is still learning lead training and needs a bit of extra support with her house training, but her sweet temperament and willingness to learn make her a wonderful candidate for a loving family.

This beautiful girl has a calm, relaxed nature that’s hard not to fall for. Once settled into her forever home, Lucy is sure to repay all the love and kindness shown to her with loyalty, affection, and lifelong friendship.

Whoever adopts Lucy will truly be gaining a best friend for life.

name: Eric
description:
Eric is an 8–9-year-old male Cross-Breed. This distinguished gentleman is currently living in Romania under UK rescue backup, patiently waiting for the perfect retirement home.

After years of uncertainty, he deserves a peaceful and loving home where he can finally rest his paws.

A shelter is no place for a senior dog like Eric. In his later years, what he truly needs is a warm bed, a soft blanket, and a quiet corner next to the fire.

It would be his greatest wish to find a home before the cold winter sets in. Eric dreams of spending his golden years surrounded by comfort, care, and companionship.

Health-wise, Eric is in good shape with no known medical concerns, allergies, or food intolerances. He’s a calm and gentle soul who would thrive in a relaxed environment where his humans can devote time and love to him.

A retired person or couple looking for a low-energy, affectionate companion would be ideal.

Eric would love a garden to wander around at his own pace, enjoying fresh air and short bursts of activity. He’s not suited to living with cats or small children but could share his home with a calm female dog.

Short walks, time in the garden, and plenty of naps would suit him perfectly.

His rescuers emphasise that adopting a dog like Eric requires patience, understanding, and long-term commitment. Rescue dogs may carry emotional baggage, and some can display challenging behaviours.

However, with kindness and consistency, Eric is sure to reward his adopters with unconditional love and loyalty.

name: Ricky
description:
Ricky, a 1.5-year-old male with a small stature cross-breed, seeks a loving family from Romania.

His journey began with abandonment, leaving his parentage a mystery, but his resilient spirit shines bright as he searches for a home to call his own.

Despite the challenges he’s faced, Ricky’s gentle nature and affinity for companionship make him an ideal furry friend for the right family.

In his interactions with other dogs, Ricky exudes kindness and tranquility, fostering harmonious relationships with his fellow canines.

Human contact brings Ricky joy, and he readily welcomes new faces without a trace of shyness. His leash manners are commendable, as he walks with ease and enthusiasm through the shelter fields, relishing the opportunity to explore his surroundings.

While in the shelter, Ricky has had positive interactions with children, showcasing his adaptable and amiable nature in various social settings.

Though Ricky has made strides in his journey, he still requires guidance and training in certain aspects of dog ownership, such as car rides and recall.

Therefore, an ideal home for Ricky would be one that offers patience, understanding, and support as he continues to adjust to his new life.

A secure garden would provide Ricky with space for play and ongoing training, while older children would complement his temperament and energy level.

Ricky comes with a clean bill of health, having been vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, microchipped, and neutered.

With his past behind him and a bright future ahead, Ricky eagerly awaits the opportunity to bring joy and companionship to a compassionate family.

name: Grace
description:
Grace is a 3-month-old female dog, a small cross breed, currently residing in a private shelter in Romania. She has received her vaccinations, including DHPPi/RL and KC vaccines, and has undergone blood testing.

Grace is also microchipped and receives regular flea and worm treatments. Currently unspayed due to her age, she awaits a caring and understanding home that can support her in her development.

Grace, along with her sister Ruby, was found roaming at the side of the road and is currently under the care of rescuer Andreea Berar. While in rescue, Grace has not displayed any behavioural issues.

However, it is acknowledged that the transition from shelter to a home environment may bring about different assessments and challenges. Grace will need time, patience, and support to adjust to her new surroundings.

Specific areas requiring attention include toilet training and lead training, suggesting that she would benefit from beginner training classes with her new owner to strengthen their bond.

To facilitate a smooth transition, Grace should be given a few days to explore her new house and garden before introducing the harness and leads gradually.

It is emphasised that exercise should not be the main focus during this initial period, allowing her to acclimatise to her new environment, including people, sounds, scents, and sensations.

In terms of compatibility, Grace has lived with other dogs in the shelter, showing a positive disposition towards them. However, her interaction with cats has not been tested in the shelter environment.

Grace’s health has improved significantly since her rescue, with treatment addressing her initial coat condition. Ongoing care includes a coat supplement and regular flea treatment.

The ideal home for Grace would be calm, providing structure and time for her to decompress from the move. A secure garden with at least a 5ft boundary is recommended to ensure her safety.

For potential adopters, it’s important to note that an application and checks are mandatory. If selected, a 90-minute adoption chat and a home check will be part of the process to ensure the best match for Grace’s well-being.

name: Ruby
description:
Ruby is a charming 3-month-old female, a petite mixed breed currently sheltered in Romania. Ruby, with her tiny frame, has already received DHPPi/RL and KC vaccinations, undergone blood testing, and is microchipped.

Despite her young age, she has been diligent about flea and worm treatments. Found alongside her sister Grace, Ruby’s journey brought her under the compassionate care of rescuer Andreea Berar.

Ruby’s behavioural history in the shelter has been promising, displaying no notable issues. However, the transition from a shelter to a home environment necessitates a unique assessment.

She is not acclimated to the comforts of home living and will need the support, time, and patience of an understanding adopter. Special attention is required for toilet and lead training, making beginner training classes a valuable investment once she has settled.

Exercise, a crucial aspect of a dog’s well-being, is approached with care for Ruby. The recommendation is to allow her a few days to explore her new home and garden before introducing harnesses and leads gradually.

The emphasis is on a gradual progression, starting with leisurely strolls along the street before undertaking a full walk. Ruby’s successful integration into her new surroundings depends on her becoming familiar with the people, sounds, scents, and sensations.

Ruby’s compatibility with other animals is outlined. She hasn’t cohabited with cats in the shelter, and while she currently lives harmoniously with other dogs, a gradual introduction to new canine companions is advised.

The food test has revealed no allergies or intolerances, and her coat, once in a compromised condition, has significantly improved with ongoing treatment. A good coat supplement and regular flea treatment are recommended for her continued well-being.

Prospective adopters are encouraged to provide Ruby with a calm home environment that offers structure and time for her to decompress from the move.

In the pursuit of providing Ruby with the loving home she deserves, Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue UK oversees the adoption process.

name: Dingo
description:
Meet Dingo, an adorable and cheerful dog with a heart full of love to give.

Dingo is a 2 year old medium male Cross-Breed.

Despite facing challenges during his time on the streets, Dingo has remained resilient and is now grateful to be safe and cared for. He is described as very friendly, quickly forming bonds with both humans and his furry companions.

While he may be a bit cautious at first, Dingo’s warm and sociable nature shines through once he gets to know someone. His love for running and jumping adds to his playful personality, making him an ideal companion for active individuals or families.

Dingo pledges to be the best dog in the world for whoever adopts him, promising unwavering loyalty and affection.

Dingo is a medium-sized male dog of mixed breed, born in 2022. Residing in Bosnia, he has shown positive behaviours such as being accustomed to wearing a collar, walking on a lead, and responding to his name.

Additionally, Dingo has received essential care, including vaccinations, blood tests (with good results), flea and worm treatments, neutering, and microchipping.

Dingo’s journey to find his forever home is facilitated by Rbu – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK, where potential adopters can apply and undergo necessary checks to ensure a suitable match. If you’re looking for a loyal and loving companion, Dingo might just be the perfect match for you.

Application and checks apply through Rbu – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

name: Freya
description:
Freya is a 2-3-year-old female cross-breed currently residing with the team at Azil Dubrovnik in Croatia.

On Valentine’s Day, she was discovered abandoned with her puppy, Amor, in the middle of nowhere. It was a harrowing experience as Freya, understandably protective of her little one, ran in panic, taking hours to be caught.

Eventually, with enough courage, she allowed rescuers to approach and save her baby.

Her past life remains a mystery, but she’s been promised the best from now on, with hopes of finding her forever home soon.

Initially shy, Freya has a remarkably gentle and affectionate character. Despite whatever hardships she may have faced, she adores people unconditionally.

Cuddling is one of her favorite activities, and she appreciates every gentle touch she receives.

The search is on for the perfect family to give Freya the love and security she deserves, ensuring that her sad story transforms into a happy ending.

name: Iskra
description:
Iskra is a 2 year old female Kangal. She is calm, gentle with children, graceful, loving, and never demanding.

She was a puppy – on a chain. No walks, no play, no freedom. In July of last year, we were finally able to rescue her. From her very first day at the shelter, she showed us how beautiful her soul is.

She loves people and other dogs – and everyone loves her. She was perfect – but to many, she was simply “too big.” So she remained at the shelter for months. Iskra is calm, gentle with children, graceful, loving, and never demanding.

She has so much love for people, no matter what has been done to her. Just look how relaxed she is surrounded by unfamiliar children… Two months ago, she got the chance to move into a foster home.

And from that day on, her real life began. Iskra immediately fell in love with the sofa – and with her new housemates, whether human or animal. She lives with five other dogs, including a dominant male and female, and gets along with all of them.

She also lives peacefully with four cats. She likes every dog – big, small, old, or young. She isn’t food-aggressive. She’s clumsy and simply funny.

Iskra is perfect in the city – she walks calmly on the leash, is relaxed and balanced. She doesn’t mind when people approach her – and honestly, everyone wants to pet Iskra. And she gets along with every dog she meets.

Even though she’s still young, she doesn’t need much exercise. She enjoys calm walks and travels perfectly in the car. As you can see, Iskra loves playing with other dogs. She’s very playful, but always respectful and careful. In all her time in foster care, she hasn’t shown a single problem.

She even helped care for an extremely annoying puppy – patiently and lovingly. Iskra has waited a long time to be seen. Now we hope there’s someone out there who truly sees her.

name: Osman
description:
Osman is a 2-year-old male Kangal Mix currently in foster care in Croatia. He is a large and impressive dog, weighing 54kg, with a cream-coloured coat. Despite his difficult past, Osman is friendly, loyal, and social with both people and other dogs.

He was introduced to dogs in a local town and displayed no signs of aggression, making him a great companion for a multi-dog household.

Osman was rescued from terrible conditions, where he lived on a chain alongside 67 other dogs. He was severely underweight and had lost a significant amount of muscle mass due to his confinement.

Since being in the care of his rescuers, he has been steadily regaining his strength. Though he still has some muscle to build, he is making remarkable progress every day.

He recently had an outing to the city and impressed everyone he met. He was calm, friendly, and enjoyed attention from strangers. Osman also handled the car ride well, though he was a little nervous when large trucks passed by. His confidence is improving, and with time, he will continue to grow into a well-adjusted companion.

Osman is an active dog who will thrive in a home that can provide him with both physical and mental stimulation. He does need some support with lead training, as he currently pulls a bit, but with positive reinforcement, he will learn to walk nicely on a lead.

His ideal home would be with an experienced large-breed owner who understands guardian breeds.

A home in the countryside, away from heavy traffic, would suit him best. He needs an owner who is physically fit and able to handle a dog of his size.

Osman would also benefit from a spacious home and garden where he can enjoy his surroundings. He is neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, and has a passport, ready to travel to his forever home.

name: Lonely
description:
Lonely is a 6 year old male Cross-Breed. Lonely is a dog who came from the Žarkovica shelter in Croatia, where he was fearful and mistrustful of people.

After a lot of effort, love, and care, he has transformed into a loyal and devoted companion with the team.

He now enjoys walks, gets along well with other dogs, and feels more at ease with people, but this needs continued care.

He is healthy and has learned basic commands. We are looking for a home with someone or a family who has experience with dogs, patience, and is ready to give him the safety and love he deserves.

He is 50 cm in height and 21 kg in weight, vaccinated, flea and worm treated, neutered, and blood tested.

Once a lonely dog, now transforming into a lovely boy.

name: Lina
description:
Lina is a beautiful female dog who, unfortunately, was abandoned on the street in Croatia.

Although she may appear older at first glance, Lina is estimated by the vet to be only 5 years old.

She is extremely friendly and gets along well with other dogs.

She is always ready to play, but above all, she craves human touch.

Lina walks perfectly on the leash and thoroughly enjoys exploring away from her kennel. Lina isn’t accustomed to living with cats or small children – older teenage children – no small furries.

If you’re looking for a loyal companion who will shower you with love, Lina is the perfect choice.

She is healthy with no known allergies or intolerances.

name: Lora
description:
Lora is a 6 month old female Cross-Breed. Lora has been through a lot in her life. As a four-month-old puppy, she ended up in a shelter because her previous owners couldn’t understand her playfulness, curiosity, and puppy testing of boundaries.

She didn’t immediately know the rules of house order, and nibbling on the couch was just one of her awkward actions.

Despite all this, Lora quickly won the hearts of many, and after several successful photoshoots, she found a home that gave her love and patience, teaching her the rules and giving her a safe place to live.

However, the circumstances changed and Lora ended up in the shelter again. Now, after all she has been through, she is looking for her forever home for the third time.

Lora is 6 months old, vaccinated and chipped, soon to be neutered and still believes that she will find the right family that will love her for who she is – playful, a little mischievous, but with a full heart.

If you’re ready to give Lora all she needs and love her for the rest of her life, please consider her.

Lora is waiting for her forever home! Rbu – meadowofhopedogrecue Application and checks apply.

name: Vigo
description:
Vigo is a 12.5-year-old male Chow-Croatian cross looking for a loving home to spend his golden years.

Despite his age, he still has a zest for life and enjoys walks, water, and curling up on the sofa after a day of adventure.

He is a well-mannered and affectionate boy, great with people, dogs, and cats, making him a fantastic addition to any family home.

Vigo is well-trained, walks perfectly on a lead, and is eager to please, ensuring he will settle into a new home with ease.

Fully vaccinated, blood tested, neutered, flea and worm treated, and microchipped, Vigo is ready to travel to the UK in March via Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue.

If you’re looking for a loyal, loving companion, Vigo could be the perfect match.

name: Viva
description:
Viva is an 8-year-old female Cross-Breed. She is a senior lady with a heart full of love, looking for a warm and caring home to spend her golden years.

Despite a past that may not have been the kindest, she remains full of spirit and affection, ready to give and receive love.

Throughout her life, Viva has been nurturing and caring, and now it’s her turn to receive the love and attention she deserves.

She gets along wonderfully with other dogs and even cats, making her a perfect fit for a multi-pet household. Her gentle and friendly nature means she will easily become a cherished companion.

At 50 cm tall and weighing 22 kg, Viva is a medium-sized dog with a sturdy build. She may be a senior, but she still has plenty of companionship and devotion to offer.

Her loving nature and calm temperament make her an ideal dog for someone looking for a loyal and affectionate friend.

Viva is fully vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, microchipped, and spayed. She is currently in Croatia but can travel to the UK through Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue once she finds a home.

Adopting Viva means giving a second chance to a dog who truly deserves it—one who will fill your home with love and loyalty.

name: Spirit
description:
Hello there! My name’s Spirit, a 3 year old male Cross-Breed from Romania, full of life and energy.

I was rescued from a field where I was attached to a chain 24 hours a day. My fur was matted, my skin was sore, and I was crawling with fleas—it was so uncomfortable for me.

Succeeding Paragraphs (Copied and Punctuated):

Despite those awful days, weeks and years of my life, I remain forgiving and happy.

I’m super friendly with people, other dogs, and children over 10.

I love to play, run around and roll in the long grass now that I am free from those horrible chains.I currently reside in private foster in Romania under the care of NGO Andreea.

I am super excited for what the future holds for me and what adventures can be made now that I have a new lease of life.

name: Milo
description:
Milo is a 3 year old male Cross-Breed, small to medium in size, standing 33cm tall and weighing 11kg.

He was abandoned in a park in Tecuci, Romania, and was going to eat at a rescuer’s door.

After being taken in by a kind lady and her daughter, Milo struggled to fit in with their two dogs, leading them to seek help.

Today, Milo is completely integrated with the other 30 dogs in the rescue yard. He is a gorgeous, cuddly dog who loves human contact and enjoys being petted and stroked.

He is sociable with other dogs and does not show any aggression towards the rescue’s cats. Milo is castrated, vaccinated, microchipped, and dewormed, with an EU passport and a full adoption contract.

He can live, after gradual introduction, with other dogs, cats, and children. Adopting a dog is a very big decision, so please make sure you are ready for the challenge and commitment.

Are you prepared to take care of them, pay their vet bills, feed them, walk them, and consider them a family member for the rest of their life?

name: Ljubica
description:
Ljubica is a 13 year old female Cross-Breed is a medium-sized dog weighing 21 kilograms and standing 46 cm tall. Currently located in Croatia, Ljubica has spent her entire life in a shelter and is now ready to find her forever home.

Ljubica wants a patient home where the residents won’t expect her to shower them with affection and kisses straight away. It’s clear that she has had little human affection during her incredibly difficult life.

In a retirement home, she wants the freedom to live her life at her own pace.

Ljubica has never behaved aggressively towards those who care for her. She is simply a fearful soul, and it breaks our hearts that such a lovely dog is frightened of anything in this world.

She would thrive in a household with another calm and friendly dog. Ljubica is still learning to walk on the lead and will need time and understanding to settle.

She is vaccinated, microchipped, spayed, and has her passport ready. Ljubica is looking for someone who will love and care for her in her golden years.

If you are looking for a loyal and loving friend, Ljubica is here, ready to start her new life with you.

name: Rio
description:
Meet Rio: Rio is a 3 1/2 year old male Siberian Husky currently located in Croatia and available for adoption.

Sadly, he never had a real home. Life in a derelict box, without going out, we can’t call home, nor is it the life that any creature deserves. We cannot change the past, but we can guarantee a wonderful future.

Rio is a cheerful dog, full of life and desire for adventure. He is not trained to live in a home, and we are looking for a home with a fenced garden so that he can slowly get used to entering inside. He rejoices at all people and jumps a meter high when people approach his box. He adores cats and has shared boxing with them.

Rio is vaccinated, chipped, and neutered. In other words, he is ready to start his new life with someone who will love and care for him.

If you are looking for a friend forever, Rio is here, ready to give you all his love!

name: Blossom
description:
Blossom is a 5-year-old female Cross-Breed who will turn 6 in December. She is a medium-sized dog currently located in Romania, waiting for her forever home through Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

Fully vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, microchipped, and spayed, Blossom is well-prepared for her next chapter in a loving home.

With a heart full of love and an eagerness to please, Blossom’s friendly demeanour makes her a joy to be around. She has a naturally gentle and calm personality, making her an excellent companion for peaceful and cosy moments at home.

Whether it’s a movie night on the sofa or a quiet evening with a book, she’ll happily be by your side, soaking up all the affection she can get.

Loyalty is one of Blossom’s greatest strengths. She is the kind of dog who will stand by her family through thick and thin, offering unwavering companionship.

Her affectionate nature means she thrives on human interaction and loves to cuddle. Anyone looking for a devoted and loving pet will find the perfect match in Blossom.

Blossom is dog-friendly and has already been lead-trained, making her an easy companion for walks and outdoor adventures. She can also be cat-tested upon request for potential adopters with feline family members.

Given her gentle and social nature, she would make a wonderful addition to the right home, bringing warmth, joy, and unconditional love.

name: Viva
description:
Viva is an 8-year-old female cross breed dog currently looking for a foster home. She is a loving and loyal companion who radiates warmth and positivity.

Despite being a senior, she still has plenty of love to give and embodies the gentle, calm nature that makes older dogs such wonderful companions.

Viva is friendly with both dogs and cats, making her a great addition to a multi-pet household. She is fully vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, microchipped, and spayed.

Her travel costs from Croatia to the UK are covered by the voluntary organisation, and she is available through Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue.

If you are looking for a devoted friend and a sweet, affectionate dog to brighten your home, fostering Viva could be a truly rewarding experience.

name: Golda
description:
Golda is a 10-year-old female Cross-Breed with a heart as pure as gold. She has spent much of her life navigating the streets, demonstrating remarkable resilience and strength. Despite her difficult past, she remains a gentle and shy soul, always radiating a quiet charm that makes her truly special.

Golda prefers a peaceful environment over a busy, bustling one. She is the kind of dog who would rather curl up by your side than run around in a crowded park. Her calm and patient nature makes her a wonderful companion for those who appreciate a serene and soothing presence at home.

Although she has seen many challenges in life, Golda remains full of love to give. She has a sweet and endearing personality that will bring warmth to any home. She is well-behaved and content with a simple life, making her a perfect match for someone looking for a low-energy, loving companion.

Golda gets along well with other dogs and can live harmoniously with cats. However, she would be best suited to an adult-only home, where she can enjoy a quiet and relaxed environment.

Having already been vaccinated, blood-tested, flea and worm treated, microchipped, and spayed, Golda is ready to find her forever home.

If you’re looking for a loyal and affectionate companion to share peaceful moments with, Golda is the perfect choice. She is waiting for a special person to give her the love and security she truly deserves.

Adopt Golda and let her spend her golden years surrounded by warmth, care, and unconditional love.

name: Gia
description:
Introducing Gia! Once upon a time, on a mountain in Croatia, a beautiful dog with a poorly leg wandered aimlessly after she was hit by a car.

Despite her physical pain, no one seemed to notice her. Gia, with her gentle eyes and a spirit that refused to be broken, longed for help, and the Zarkovica team were notified and came to her aid.

Despite her hardships, Gia harboured no ill will towards humans. Although shy, she shows no aggression towards people.

Her leg couldn’t be saved due to the trauma she suffered during those painful times, but she has since undergone surgery to remove it and has fully recovered physically.

Gia will be happiest with another dog or dogs, as she prefers their company and gains confidence when in their presence, having lived in a huge pack for most of her life. She walks wonderfully with the team and enjoys her daily outings.

Gia is fully vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, microchipped, and spayed. She will travel on approved transport with her very own passport directly to her new home.

The application and checks apply through RBU – Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue.

name: Lolek
description:
Lolek is a 3.5-month-old male Cross-Breed available for adoption. He was born approximately 3.5 months ago and can travel to his new home once he reaches 4 months, depending on the development of his teeth.

Currently located in Tecuci, Romania, Lolek is part of a small breed and is eagerly waiting for a loving family to adopt him. His breed is an unknown mix, adding to his unique charm.

Lolek has been thoroughly prepared for adoption; he is vaccinated, blood tested, treated for fleas and worms, and microchipped. With rescue back up and support available in the UK, potential adopters can feel secure in their decision to bring Lolek into their home.

A home check and adoption process will apply to ensure a suitable environment for him.

Lolek and his brother, Bolek, were found abandoned on a freezing winter day, which highlights the resilience of these little pups.

A kind lady rescued them from the streets and sought help for their care, leading to their current situation where they are receiving the love and attention they deserve. Lolek is a playful sweetheart who thrives on human interaction and loves to be pampered.

He is sociable with the other dogs in the yard, indicating his friendly disposition, and is comfortable around cats as well. This sociability makes him an ideal candidate for a home with other pets.

It is estimated that Lolek will remain small when he fully grows up, making him a perfect fit for families looking for a compact companion.

name: Noodle
description:
Meet Noodle, a 3 year old male Belgian Malinois Cross — the dog who waited for a goodbye that never came.

Noodle didn’t come from the streets. He wasn’t born unwanted. He had a home, a person, and a quiet little life. An elderly man who he followed everywhere, who he trusted completely, who he believed would never leave him.

And then, one day, that man took him to a pound. No words. No glance back. Just walked away.

We can only imagine Noodle’s confusion — how he must have pulled toward the door, waiting for the sound of familiar footsteps, for the voice that would tell him it was all a mistake. But no one came.

Days turned into weeks. His world went silent. When we found him in that kill shelter, he was still waiting — still watching the door, still believing.

And when the gate finally opened, he wagged his tail. Not in anger, not in fear — but in forgiveness. He didn’t belong there. You could see it instantly.

Personality: Intelligent, loyal, affectionate, and forgiving

He was different — too gentle, too loving, too full of light for that kind of place. Now, safe with us, Noodle shines again.

He’s a beautiful, smart, and sensitive boy who loves people with a devotion that breaks your heart a little because you know how deeply he’s been hurt. He leans into every touch.

He looks at you like you’re his whole world. And maybe, for him, you would be.

Noodle lost everything once — his home, his person, his place in the world. But he never lost his hope. If you can give this brave, forgiving boy the forever love he’s still waiting for, please message us. Noodle’s heart is ready to belong again!

name: Basil
description:
Meet Basil, a 2 year old male Labrador Retriever Cross who’s the very definition of joy on four paws.

Saved from a kill shelter in July 2025, Basil went from heartbreak to happiness—and he’s never looked back.

2 years old – the happiest boy in the world

His joy is contagious – always smiling and wagging his tail

Fantastic with everyone – people, dogs, life itself

The heart of our pension – he lights up every room

If there’s one word to describe Basil, it’slight.His happiness is contagious, his tail never stops wagging, and his smile? It can turn even the darkest day into sunshine.

He is the soul of our pension, the dog who lifts every spirit, spreads warmth, and reminds us why we rescue.

Yet, for all the joy he gives, Basil has never had someone to call his own. When he was behind bars in the kill shelter, his sadness broke all our hearts—but the moment he was freed, he never got his distant parents.

No one stepped forward to be his sponsor, his protector, the one to keep him safe until adoption.

Now, we hope someone will see him,really see him, and give him the forever home he so deeply deserves. Because if there was ever a dog who could make a family happier, brighter, and more full of love—it’s Basil.

Basil has given so much love without asking for anything in return. Now it’s his turn. If you’re looking for a dog who will fill your life with joy, laughter, and unconditional love, Basil is waiting for you.

name: Errol
description:
Errol is a 9 year old male Cross-Breed. He is a happy little soul, he just bursts with happiness at the smallest things. He doesn’t ask for much, your presence is enough to get him into ‘giddy kipper mode’ and he always has the biggest smile on his face.

It appears that Errol has not had many comforts in his life and he has been thriving here. He loves his soft beds and is particularly fond of the sofa.

Errol has some issues with his legs which we are currently investigating with our vet – this does not hold him back in any way and he still whizzes around playing.

Errol is a very sweet boy but he can be unsure of new people and will require slow introductions. Once Errol has accepted you as a friend he will always give you the very best welcome.

Errol mixes well with other dogs but he does prefer his own space and for this reason, we do feel he would be best suited to a home where he can be the only dog, however, we would consider a home with another dog if the owner is experienced.

We are unsure if Errol can live with cats at this stage. We are looking for a quiet home for Errol where any children are aged 16+. He has not displayed any signs of separation anxiety so could be left alone for a few hours.

name: Lola
description:
Lola is a 10 year old female Cross-Breed. She is a quirky girl with an inquisitive, endearing personality. She is particularly fond of soft toys.

Lola is a feral dog so she will not tolerate being touched or walked, however, she happily lived in a home for several years and does enjoy her home comforts.

Lola has been spending some time in foster where she has been the star guest – she is quiet, clean and non-destructive.

When Lola arrived with us she was extremely overweight, she is now at a healthy weight but we have discovered her history of sweet treats has resulted in her being rather fussy when it comes to eating regular dog food!

Lola has had some teeth removed and will require a soft diet. Her tongue does now stick out to the side of her mouth but we feel this just adds to her charm!

Lola is currently on medication for urinary incontinence which has been working wonders and she no longer has any accidents.

Lola does get along well with other dogs but we do feel she would be best suited to being the only dog in the home. She has previously lived with cats without any issues. Lola needs a calm, quiet household with a secure garden.

name: Storm
description:
Storm is a 6 year old female Shepherd. She first entered rescue as a very young pup at just 4 months old, showing resilience from the very beginning.

She later found her first home when she was 10 months old, but sadly, her owner has since become very unwell, leading Storm to return to rescue and spend time in kennels.

Storm’s journey hasn’t been the smoothest, but she has always had rescue support behind her, ensuring she’s never left without care.

Recently, she was brought out of kennels and is now looking for her next forever home. She requires an experienced owner of Shepherds who understands her drive and characteristics.

Storm has a naturally high prey drive, which means she isn’t suitable to live with cats or other small furry animals. However, she has been living alongside four other dogs in her current setting, which shows she can enjoy the company of her own kind.

She would be best suited to a home with a male dog, though careful introductions would always be necessary.

When it comes to people, Storm is a complete star. She adores everyone she meets and is described as being excellent within the home environment.

Her only challenge is her enthusiasm on the lead, where she tends to pull due to her excitement about getting outdoors and exploring.

Storm is a bright, affectionate, and loyal Shepherd who needs the right home to thrive. With guidance from an experienced owner, she will continue to flourish, and her loving nature will shine through.

She truly deserves stability and a family who will commit to her for the rest of her life.

name: Sherbet
description:
Sherbet is a medium sized crossbreed aged around five to six years old.

Even in the stressful setting of a public shelter, Sherbet was a little ray of sunshine. When we visited in January she was so pleased to see us and welcomed us with her very best full body wag! She is now in a UK foster home and looking for a new start with a new family.

Sherbet is a very submissive girl who spends an awful lot of her time on her back asking for belly rubs. When she knows and trusts you she is the most loyal and affectionate girl but she does take a few days to trust new people, particularly men.

She is mixing well with the dogs in her foster home but would be just as happy as the only dog in the home. She will need an adult family due to her initial nervousness with new people.

name: Micky
description:
Micky is a medium sized crossbreed aged around four years old.

Micky was brought to Roxana’s shelter in Romania by a kind lady who found him abandoned in a box. He was luckily old enough not to need mum’s milk. He is a lovely friendly, people pleasing, boy.

Micky gets on great with other dogs and will need another full time resident dog in his forever home. He seems to be fine with cats and could live with respectful children aged four plus. He will need somebody who is home for a lot of the day as he doesn’t like to be left.

name: Nella
description:
Nella is a small to medium sized female crossbreed and she is around 3-4 year old.

Nella was found in a forest in Romania by a vet when she was a pup, along with her brother and sister. She took them to her village and hoped that someone would want them, but no one did.

She then received an offer of a job in Austria, which she accepted. None of her friends would help her with the puppies, finally, she asked our colleagues at dog rescue Norway for a space at their shelter in Crivatu where they stayed for over a year.

Nella has now been in her UK foster home for a few months working on her shyness but us now ready to find her perfect forever home.

Nella is still a shy and reserved little girl but once she knows you she is sweet and affectionate. She will need a home with another dog that she can seek comfort and confidence from whilst she adjusts to her new life.

She would like a quietish home environment with no children under the age of ten and has no issues with cats.

name: Hilda
description:
Hilda is a 5 year old female Carpathian Sheepdog Cross. She is fostered in Norwich Norfolk. We have been a part of Hilda’s life and her a part of ours for over two years.
